resources.string: Units of weight are measurements that are used to express the mass or weight of an object. Try converting units of weight now!

The GroceryScale application is a simple application designed to help users in converting food weight units such as grams, kilograms, ounces, and pounds quickly and easily. This application is suitable for use when shopping or cooking, making it easy for users to adjust the measurements according to their needs. 

\This application was created to fulfill the Assessment requirement for the Programming for Mobile Devices 1 course.

Here are the procedures for using the GroceryScale application : 

 1. Enter the number you want to convert in the input column provided. Make sure the number entered matches the weight unit you want to convert.

 2. Select the initial unit of the number you entered, then also select the destination unit you want to change so that the conversion results match your needs.

 3. Then click the Results button to display the conversion results based on your input and unit selection.

 4. If you want to share the conversion results, click the Share button to share the conversion results via other applications.
